cohort: 8780 children with ALL, 1332 children with AML, and 23,459 controls
finding: Prelabor caesarean delivery was significantly associated with an increased risk of childhood ALL, while emergency caesarean delivery and all indications of caesarean delivery were not.
mod_finding: Prelabor cesarean delivery was significantly associated with an increased risk of childhood ALL (OR 1.23 [1.04-1.47]; p=0.018).
country: Canada, Costa Rica, Egypt, France, Germany, Greece, Italy, New Zealand, and the USA
